campaign.title: M1 lower-cone indefinite-theta completion gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary indefinite-theta, mock/false-theta, Appell-Lerch, modular-completion, and summation-formula sources only after deriving the exact signature-(1,1) lattice, cone kernel, odd coset, and chi_4 factor. Record theorem number, lattice integrality, boundary-vector hypotheses, isotropic limits, weight, level, multiplier, nonholomorphic correction, cusp growth, test-function class, complex-direction placement, and the full R-M-N capacity.

frozen_target.question: Does the exact one-sided divisor-cone generating series for C(m) admit a source-legal signature-(1,1) indefinite-theta, mock, or Appell-Lerch completion whose complete transformation law yields the fixed-centre nonresonant cone target, or a strictly smaller owner-complete signed survivor; if not, what is the first exact lattice-kernel, isotropic-boundary, completion, source-hypothesis, complex-direction, mask, or capacity obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor X, M_*~R^2, k_m=floor(sqrt(Nm)+1/2), C(m)=sum_(hr=m,r odd,r>4h)chi_4(r), and F(tau)=sum_(h>=1,r>4h,r odd)chi_4(r)e(hr tau)=sum_(m>=1)C(m)e(m tau). The exact open scalar is T_N=sum_M sum_(m in [M,2M) intersect [1,M_*], |k_m^2-Nm|>sqrt M) m^(-3/4)V_low(R^2m/N)C(m)e(sqrt(Nm)), with target T_N<<_epsilon X^epsilon uniformly for every real X.
quantities: The proposed automorphic object is F(tau), whose exponent hr is a genuine quadratic form. The nonlinear phase e(sqrt(Nm)) is not itself a theta phase and may not be relabelled as one.

Round 63 already proved the exact pole-free moving level-four Appell identity and four-term completion. The genuinely new seam is reconciliation with the later Round-141/142 floor-free nonresonant owner, hard mask, rational hierarchy, and Abel return; rediscovery of the Appell identity is not progress.
The lattice, quadratic and bilinear forms, strict cone, odd-r cosets, chi_4 factor, opposite cones, and both boundaries must be exact before any source theorem is invoked.
One boundary is isotropic for Q(h,r)=hr. Any limiting, regularization, or Appell-Lerch passage must state its convergence, correction terms, multiplier, and cusp behavior.

The holomorphic coefficient must remain exactly C(m). A completion that reconstructs r_2/4, a full divisor coefficient, or an opposite-cone combination is not an owner reduction unless the residual is proved target-safe.
Every nonholomorphic, unary, boundary, residue, continuous, and cusp term is part of the owner ledger.

A modular transformation must be converted into a lawful coefficient summation formula with a test class accepting the literal smooth weight and hard nonresonant mask. An individual complex direction may not be replaced by a cosine or conjugate pair without an exact bridge.
The complete R-M-N power ledger must be compared with X^epsilon for the normalized scalar and with the accepted Round-142 owner. Formal automorphy or transform self-return is not a gain.

This round concerns the Round-141/142 floor-free nonresonant cone scalar only. It cannot by itself promote the collar-tail cross term, complete lower GAR, either direct M1 parent, M9-M1, any M2 owner, endpoint, M9, or the global theorem.

completion_criteria: Derive or refute an exact signature-(1,1) lattice/coset/kernel identity for F(tau), including strict inequalities, both boundaries, odd-r support, chi_4, convergence, and all opposite-cone terms.

Classify the exact modular status of F and, if a completion exists, state its weight, level, multiplier, transformation law, cusp growth, shadow, nonholomorphic correction, isotropic limiting terms, and boundary distributions.
Audit primary theorems against the exact lattice integrality, negative or isotropic boundary vectors, character/coset data, regularization, and test hypotheses.
Derive the strongest lawful coefficient or Voronoi-type summation formula available for C(m), retaining the individual complex direction and all completion pieces.
Insert the literal dyadic weight and nonresonant mask, restore every endpoint, and compute the full R-M-N capacity of the holomorphic, correction, and boundary pieces.
Check compatibility with the accepted all-4-divisible rational-mode hierarchy, denominator-Abel r_2/4 return, negative-character survivor, and principal stationary self-return.
Prove the fixed-centre target, produce a strictly smaller owner-complete signed survivor, or identify the first rigorous obstruction without upgrading capacity to a lower bound.
Close under exactly one label: target_bound, strict_automorphic_cone_reduction, or indefinite_theta_completion_no_go.

Every modular/mock/indefinite-theta claim matches a primary theorem, including isotropic limiting hypotheses, weight, multiplier, nonholomorphic correction, shadow, cusps, and convergence.

closing_assessment.main_result: The nonzero nearest-square displacement count is O_epsilon(JX^epsilon), so the exact lower-cone scalar is target-equivalent to the strict survivor |k_m^2-Nm|>M^(3/4). The completed Appell torsion section is scalar of weight one with chi_4 on Gamma_0(4), but its five-owner coefficient pairing and exact character-Poisson transform return the same reciprocal owner after global restoration. The sharper survivor remains open.
